tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Night is true black: the screen is dark until something needs a person.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: inputs, switches, the terminal bar and segmented controls.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels (tonal: separated by tone, no border). A lit card stays raised; its status is the edge, the mark and the word.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and hover rows.

tokens.name: lifted
tokens.usage: The one step above raised: an opened row or card, the top card of a decision deck, a sheet. Night is a lighter grey; Day has no third white, so lifted carries shadow-1 (and shadow-2 when open) instead.

tokens.name: edge-hi
tokens.usage: The 1px machined highlight along the top edge of a lifted surface (inset 0 1px 0). Decorative; never a divider.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside cards and tables.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default hairline: card footers, table header rule, chips.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, switches); meets 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Section rules and chart axes where a card has no box. Decorative; never the only cue.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and data values on canvas, surface and raised.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, values in inline data.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Labels, keys, timestamps and captions on any surface (4.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: fg-dim
tokens.usage: Separators and disabled marks only. Never body text.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, tile, tab or lane: the fill. Selection is neutral: tiles add a 1px fg ring, rows a 2px fg leading edge; never a brand wash.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Signal yellow. Primary action fill, focus, the active route. Never a status.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: brand-wash
tokens.usage: Deprecated since theme-v12: no Airframe rule uses it. Selection is `selected` with a fg ring or edge; never tint a surface with brand. Kept so older product CSS still resolves.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (11.7:1).

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand as text or 1px line: the critical path, the now line, links. Day uses dark gold for contrast.

tokens.name: brand-line
tokens.usage: Brand-colored strokes on the page: link underlines, the hub outline in diagrams, the eyebrow rule. Day darkens it so a 1px line still reads.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: Running: quiet by design (dark cockpit). Filled circle.

tokens.name: status-queued
tokens.usage: Queued: hollow ring.

tokens.name: status-approval
tokens.usage: Needs a human: the diamond, the word, and the 3px edge on the leading side of a lit card, row or tile. Never a fill or a tint. Orange so it never reads as the yellow brand.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Failed: the triangle, the word, and the 3px edge of a stopped row or tile. Never a fill.

tokens.name: status-denied
tokens.usage: Policy denied: placard fill with white text.

tokens.name: on-status-denied
tokens.usage: Text on the denied placard (4.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: status-off
tokens.usage: Spun down or expired: small dot.

tokens.name: lamp-caution
tokens.usage: Master caution lamp fill (black text). The only large color block in the UI.

tokens.name: lamp-warning
tokens.usage: Master warning lamp fill (black text).

tokens.name: on-lamp
tokens.usage: Text on lamp fills.

tokens.name: terminal-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal and code blocks stay dark in both themes.

tokens.name: terminal-fg
tokens.usage: Terminal text.

tokens.name: terminal-dim
tokens.usage: Terminal prompts, comments and the window bar.

tokens.name: terminal-ok
tokens.usage: Terminal success lines (quiet).

tokens.name: terminal-err
tokens.usage: Terminal failure lines.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Code: keywords and flags.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Code: functions and commands.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Code: strings.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Code: numbers and digests.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Code: comments.

tokens.name: span-model
tokens.usage: Trace: model-call spans (solid).

tokens.name: span-tool
tokens.usage: Trace: tool-call spans (1px outline, faint fill).

tokens.name: span-sandbox
tokens.usage: Trace: sandbox command spans (solid, mid grey).

tokens.name: stage-plan
tokens.usage: Lanes and fleet board: plan stage.

tokens.name: stage-edit
tokens.usage: Lanes and fleet board: edit stage.

tokens.name: stage-test
tokens.usage: Lanes and fleet board: test stage. PR is drawn as an outline in fg-muted.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Stage rail, ring and capsule track: the part not yet travelled.

tokens.name: rail-done
tokens.usage: Stage rail, ring and capsule fill: the part done, and the rail head. A lit agent's head and current segment take its status color instead.

tokens.name: rail-glow
tokens.usage: The soft glow around a live rail head and the latest timeline dot (0 0 12px). The one glow in the system; it says 'moving', never a status.

tokens.name: readout-cell
tokens.usage: Unlit cell behind each digit of a readout.

tokens.name: display-window
tokens.usage: Recessed window that holds readouts.

tokens.name: dot-field
tokens.usage: Optional dot field texture (8px pitch) behind hero data.

tokens.name: product-hangar
tokens.usage: hangar mark and nav marker only.

tokens.name: product-flightdeck
tokens.usage: flightdeck mark and nav marker only.

tokens.name: product-tower
tokens.usage: Tower (the governed workspace) mark and nav marker only.

tokens.name: product-aidlc
tokens.usage: ai-dlc mark and nav marker only.

tokens.name: product-spaceport
tokens.usage: Spaceport mark and nav marker only.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (primary). Charts are greyscale plus one attention series.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Attention series (shares the caution color on purpose).

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 / grid emphasis.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Card and panel titles that need the brand face.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, keys, buttons and section names, in sentence case. Mono capitals were retired in theme-v12; mono stays for IDs, numbers and commands.

styles.name: label-s
styles.usage: Inline data keys, table headers and stage words, in sentence case.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and readouts (tabular figures).

tokens.name: display-stretch
tokens.usage: Archivo's width axis at 125% gives Archivo Expanded. Set font-stretch with the display family.

tokens.name: display-weight
tokens.usage: Display weight: headlines and product names.

tokens.name: display-track
tokens.usage: Display letter-spacing.

tokens.name: label-track
tokens.usage: Tracking for the mono capitals that remain: the denied placard, the lamp legend and the terminal bar. Labels are sentence-case sans since theme-v12.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, pip spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tile gaps on the fleet board, icon-to-text in chips.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label, button gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Card grid gap, inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding (regular), page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section inner spacing.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding (airy), panel gaps.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Large section gap.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Section padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Section padding.

tokens.name: space-104
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding.

tokens.name: space-160
tokens.usage: Hero top spacing.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tables, lanes, trace bars.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, tags, segments, fleet tiles, the denied placard. Was 2px before theme-v12.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, agent rows and board cards. Was 4px before theme-v12.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The opened sheet: an agent's console, the top card of the decision deck, a dialog.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status dots, heartbeat dots and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting lift under a lifted surface (with the edge-hi top highlight). Night barely shows it; Day needs it, having no third white.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: An opened sheet or the top card of a deck: the one deep shadow. Never on a resting card.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and toasts.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: App header height.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Table and list row height.

tokens.name: row-h-compact
tokens.usage: Dense tables.

tokens.name: lane-h
tokens.usage: Session lane row height.

tokens.name: span-h
tokens.usage: Trace span row height.

tokens.name: rail-h
tokens.usage: Stage rail and capsule thickness.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width on the 20 px icon grid (scales with size).

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Default icon size in UI; 20 px in nav and headers.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: A press, a hover tint, a heartbeat tick.

tokens.name: dur
tokens.usage: Color, background, border and opacity transitions.

tokens.name: dur-open
tokens.usage: Something opening or closing in place: a row's console, a deck card leaving, a drawer.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: The default deceleration curve.

tokens.name: ease-open
tokens.usage: Open and close in place: decelerates, never overshoots. No springs.
